ValidationRule.description: SecureSync Training Completed must be today's date or past date. It cannot be the Future.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DP New Customer Setup" && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(SecureSync_Training_Completed__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(SecureSync_Training_Completed__c )) && DATEVALUE(SecureSync_Training_Completed__c ) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(SecureSync_Training_Completed__c )) || DATEVALUE(SecureSync_Training_Completed__c ) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(SecureSync_Training_Completed__c )) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(SecureSync_Training_Completed__c )) && DATEVALUE(SecureSync_Training_Completed__c ) > TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SecureSync Training Completed must be today's date or past date. It cannot be the Future.
